records.rationale: A gentle introduction to interactive grader calls and eliminating candidates from feedback;useful before harder query-budget tasks.
Reverse construction and compact DP states connect graph structure with weighted independent-set reasoning;best after ordinary tree DP.
Incremental graph constraints connect degree/cycle invariants and maintaining a small candidate set;valuable advanced DSU enrichment.
A strong lesson in expanding state to recover deterministic transitions,then using functional-graph paths and cycles for route queries.
Excellent prefix/suffix feasibility DP practice:deduce what holds across all valid constructions rather than return just one solution.
